title: Beyond Policy Discrepancy: Capability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.26950v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates domain specialists into a shared student, but determining how strongly each teacher should supervise remains challenging. Existing discrepancy-based allocation can assign strong supervision even when the student already matches or exceeds the teacher's task performance, since behavioral mismatch does not necessarily imply a remaining capability deficit. We propose Capability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (CA-MOPD), which combines specialist merging with capability-guided allocation to account for what the student has already learned. CA-MOPD first merges reinforcement-learning specialists into a strong student initialization, then uses verifier-estimated teacher--student capability gaps to adjust domain-level distillation strength. Supervision decreases as capability gaps close and increases when estimated student capability regresses, while dense token-level guidance

translated_title: 超越策略差异：能力感知的多教师在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）将领域专家模型整合到一个共享的学生模型中，但如何确定每个教师应给予多强的监督仍然是一个挑战。现有的基于差异的分配方法，即使学生已经达到或超过教师的任务性能，也可能分配强监督，因为行为上的不匹配并不一定意味着还存在能力缺陷。我们提出能力感知的多教师在线策略蒸馏（CA-MOPD），它将专家模型合并与能力引导的分配相结合，以考虑学生已经学到的内容。CA-MOPD 首先将强化学习专家模型合并为强大的学生模型初始化，然后使用验证器估计的师生能力差距来调整领域级别的蒸馏强度。随着能力差距的缩小，监督强度降低；当估计的学生能力出现退化时，监督强度增加，同时结合密集的 token 级别指导……
tldr: 提出能力感知的多教师在线策略蒸馏方法 CA-MOPD，将强化学习专家模型合并与验证器估计的师生能力差距相结合，根据学生已掌握的内容动态调整各领域蒸馏强度，克服了仅基于策略差异分配监督的局限性。
en_tdlr: CA-MOPD combines reinforcement-learning specialist merging with verifier-estimated teacher-student capability gaps to dynamically adjust domain-level distillation strength based on what the student has already learned, moving beyond policy discrepancy-based supervision allocation.
